task: Visit ArXiv Help on how to withdraw an article if the submission is not yet announced.
answer: Visited the official arXiv Help page 'Withdrawing an article' at https://info.arxiv.org/help/withdraw.html. For a submission that is not yet announced, the help page (section 'Submission not yet announced') says: If your submission has not yet become publicly available you may delete or delay it. To do either of these things go to your user page and select either the Delete or Unsubmit icon. Deleting a submission will remove it from our system, unsubmitting will return it to the incomplete status allowing modification and later resubmission. If you have difficulty in doing either of these things then please contact arXiv administrators immediately. In your message be sure to include the submission identifier, an explanation of the problem, and the reason for withdrawal.
